resources.string: Companion plugin for WhoIsThis. It talks to a XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (or any board running the WhoIsThis firmware) over your local Wi-Fi and hands its camera frames to the WhoIsThis app on this phone only. Nothing is uploaded by this plugin.
Board address (empty = discover with mDNS), e.g. 192.168.1.42 or whoisthis-cam.local
Latest frame from the board (shown here only, never stored)
